eps.ov: Pop gets invited to a mascot-idol event in Osaka, and Koichi accompanies her.
Koichi and Pop get dragged into an incident when a Trigger dealer unleashes a cast of rampaging robotic crabs!
Tsukauchi's investigation into the Trigger network has hit a wall, and he turns to All Might for advice.
Koichi's in double trouble, facing down a villain who might clobber him, and Eraser Head who might arrest him!
Koichi and Pop get into more Trigger trouble, and we learn where Knuckleduster has been.
Koichi encounters Eraser Head, who reminiscences about his student days.
When he was young, Aizawa's inexperience and awkward Quirk forced him to grapple with his self-esteem.

eps.t: A Sky with No Rain Left
eps.ov: When Aizawa was a younger, he and his friend Shirakumo were forced into a fight with a giant villain...
With his legal problems soon to be taken care of, Captain Celebrity makes plans to return to America.
Captain Celebrity's farewell party begins, but the Scarred Man has some unpleasant surprises in store...
Captain Celebrity tries to save the Sky Egg with Koichi's help, while reminiscing on what brought him here.
The Sky Egg falls as Captain Celebrity hits his limit, with only one person capable of saving the day...
Captain Celebrity returns to the United States, and Koichi must decide what to do with his future.
